arguments.body: Hi Margaret, thanks for letting us know. I'm sorry, but we can't let ourselves in today. The tenancy requires at least 24 hours' written notice for an inspection, and holding a spare key gives no right of entry. A neighbour's report of visitors isn't an emergency. We also can't change the locks: doing that while Jonah is living there would be unlawful eviction, which is a criminal offence for you and for us, even if he is subletting. What we will do: (1) send Jonah written notice of an inspection, giving at least 24 hours, and ask him about the visitors; (2) ask a colleague to review the possible breach of the no-subletting clause (9.3) and your options, which would go through the proper legal route. It would help if you could send anything you have, such as the Airbnb listing link or your neighbour's dates and details. We'll update you by email by Monday 12 October.

Hi Jonah, the landlord would like a routine check of the flat's condition. Under your tenancy we give at least 24 hours' written notice, so no one will come in without it. Please let us know which days and times in the next week suit you, and we'll confirm in writing before anyone visits. The landlord has also been trying to reach you, so it would help if you could get in touch with us. Nothing is needed urgently. We'll be in touch again by Monday 12 October.

The tenancy requires at least 24 hours' written notice for an inspection, and holding a spare key gives no right of entry. A neighbour's report of visitors isn't an emergency. We also can't change the locks: doing that while Jonah is living there would be unlawful eviction, which is a criminal offence for you and for us, even if he is subletting. What we will do: (1) send Jonah written notice of an inspection, giving at least 24 hours, and ask him about the visitors; (2) ask a colleague to review the possible breach of the no-subletting clause (9.3) and your options, which would go through the proper legal route. It would help if you could send anything you have, such as the Airbnb listing link or your neighbour's dates and details. We'll update you by email by Monday 12 October.
